patch_description: The best-performing variant (combined score 0.63) is the 3-state constant-acceleration Kalman filter with the trend-reversal process-noise boost gate, followed by an RTS backward smoother and localized SG-hysteresis reversal suppression — critically WITHOUT the slope-lead compensation stage, which degrades noise reduction and increases lag error in the other variants. This crossover therefore combines the reversal-gated Kalman core and RTS smoother from the top-scoring script with the zero-phase local hysteresis stage shared across all high performers, drops the lead stage that hurt the 0.55–0.58 variants, and keeps the end-aligned output contract (n - window_size + 1). The gross-outlier Huber guard on the measurement covariance is retained for robustness, and the SG coefficients are precomputed for efficiency.
